camadas-longas: A long layered cut with the overall length falling to mid-back, the front lengths falling well past the collarbones. Long, seamlessly blended layers start around the collarbones and continue down to the ends, removing bulk while keeping the perimeter full and gently rounded. Soft middle or slightly off-center part, natural lift at the roots and crown, smooth flowing lengths with soft movement and gently tapered, healthy ends. No bangs. Polished, effortless finish. Keep the natural hair texture.
corte-em-v: A long V-cut: the hair falls to mid-back, and the back perimeter is cut into a clear V shape, so the center back is the longest point and the lengths become gradually shorter toward the sides and front. Long layers start around the collarbones and blend down into the V, giving the lengths movement and lightness while the tips taper softly to a point. Middle part, smooth crown, sleek flowing lengths with soft, slightly piecey tapered ends. No bangs. Keep the natural hair texture.
corte-reto-longo: A long blunt one-length cut: all the hair falls to the same length just below the shoulder blades, cut perfectly straight across in a strong, clean horizontal perimeter, with no visible layers, no shorter front pieces and no bangs. The ends are thick, dense and crisp, with full weight at the bottom. Middle part, hair hanging smooth, heavy and straight-edged down the back and over the shoulders, natural root volume, glossy polished finish. Keep the natural hair texture.
repicado-longo: A long choppy layered cut (repicado): the overall length reaches just past the shoulder blades, with many visible layers of different lengths starting around the chin and continuing through the lengths. The layers are point-cut and texturized so the ends look light, separated and piecey, with an airy, slightly uneven perimeter. Natural volume at the crown and around the sides, lively movement throughout, relaxed tousled finish with defined, flicky ends. No bangs. Keep the natural hair texture.
corte-em-u: A long U-cut: the hair falls to mid-back, and the back perimeter is cut in a soft, rounded U shape, longest at the center and curving gently shorter toward the sides, with no sharp point. Light, long layers blend into the curve and soften the ends, while the outline stays full and dense. Middle part, smooth crown with natural lift, lengths flowing sleekly over the shoulders with softly rounded, healthy ends. No bangs. Keep the natural hair texture.
corte-borboleta-longo: A long butterfly cut: the overall length falls past the shoulder blades, with short front layers starting at the cheekbones that sweep outward like wings and blend into longer layers through the sides and back. Soft curtain-like front pieces parted in the center curve away to both sides. Styled with a voluminous round-brush blow-dry: lifted roots and crown, layers curled outward and back, bouncy feathered ends and plenty of airy movement. Smooth, glossy, glamorous, full-bodied finish.
camadas-no-rosto-longo: A long cut with front-framing layers: the back stays long and nearly one-length to mid-back, while the front sections on both sides are cut in soft graduated layers that start at the chin and fall progressively longer to the collarbones and below, curving gently away from the center. The front pieces are blended, feathered and slightly swept outward. Middle or soft side part, smooth crown, sleek lengths with a full perimeter at the back and soft, polished movement at the front. No bangs. Keep the natural hair texture.
desfiado-longo: A long razor cut (desfiado): the length reaches past the shoulder blades, and every layer and end is finely tapered with a razor so it looks thin, wispy and soft. Light layers start around the jawline and run through the lengths, with feathered, see-through ends and a fluttery, uneven perimeter. The hair looks weightless and moves freely, with soft separated strands and natural volume at the crown. Effortless, airy finish. No bangs. Keep the natural hair texture.
camadas-invisiveis: A long cut with invisible (hidden) layers: from the outside the hair looks like a full, one-length cut to mid-back with a dense, almost straight perimeter, but shorter layers are cut hidden underneath the top section. These internal layers lift and support the outer hair, giving extra body and bounce at the roots and through the mid-lengths without any visible steps on the surface. Middle part, smooth surface, full swinging lengths with thick, softly beveled ends. No bangs. Keep the natural hair texture.
escadinha-longa: A long cut with front stepped layers (escadinha): the length falls to mid-back, and the front sections on both sides are cut in clearly visible, step-like tiers, starting at chin length and descending in distinct stages to the collarbones and below, like a staircase. The back is lightly layered with a soft rounded perimeter. Side or center part, smooth crown, polished finish in which each step reads clearly, with tidy, slightly tapered ends. No bangs. Keep the natural hair texture.
shaggy-longo: A long shag: the overall length falls past the shoulder blades, with lots of choppy, disconnected layers concentrated at the crown and top, starting short at the cheekbones and growing longer toward the ends. Wispy curtain bangs parted in the center blend into the front layers. Strong volume and texture on top and at the sides, thinner, airy, tapered ends at the bottom. Tousled, lived-in, rock-inspired finish with separated, piecey strands. Keep the natural hair texture.
corte-sereia: A long mermaid cut: very long hair falling to the lower back, with delicate long layers that start at the collarbones and keep the length full and flowing. Soft front pieces fall from cheekbone level into long, gentle lines. Styled in loose, soft, cascading beach waves from the mid-lengths to the ends, with smooth roots, natural shine and soft, airy, slightly tousled ends. Middle part, no bangs. Effortless, romantic, flowing finish with realistic, defined wave pattern strand by strand.
corte-bordado: A long cut with textured 'bordado' ends: the hair falls to just below the shoulder blades in an almost one-length shape, but the last few centimeters are deeply point-cut and notched, so the perimeter looks light, irregular and slightly see-through, with fine, feathered, uneven tips instead of a blunt line. Minimal layering above, smooth surface, middle part, natural root volume. The ends move freely and separate into soft wispy points. No bangs. Keep the natural hair texture.
corte-cascata: A long cascade (waterfall) layered cut: the length reaches mid-back, and continuous layers begin high, around the cheekbones, then fall progressively longer all the way down, so the hair tumbles in successive tiers like a waterfall. Each layer is softly blended and slightly beveled, giving lots of movement, body at the crown and rounded fullness through the lengths. Middle or soft side part, bouncy, flowing finish with the ends of each tier curving gently outward. No bangs. Keep the natural hair texture.
ghost-layers-longo: A long cut with ghost layers: the hair falls to mid-back with a soft, nearly one-length outline, while very fine, almost imperceptible layers are slide-cut throughout the interior. There are no visible steps; the hair simply looks lighter, airier and more mobile, with a gentle swing, soft natural lift at the crown and wispy, weightless, softly tapered ends. Middle part, smooth glossy surface and effortless, lived-in movement. No bangs. Keep the natural hair texture.
wolf-cut-longo: A long wolf cut: heavy, shaggy, choppy layers at the crown and top, cut short around the cheekbones and jawline, transitioning into longer, thinner, wispy lengths that fall past the shoulders to the shoulder blades, like a soft long mullet. Center-parted curtain bangs blend into the front layers. Big volume and texture on top and at the sides, piecey separated strands, tapered airy ends. Tousled, edgy, undone finish. Keep the natural hair texture.
camadas-blowout-anos-90: A long 90s blowout layered cut: the hair falls just past the shoulder blades, with long rounded layers starting at the chin and front pieces beginning at the cheekbones. Styled with a big round-brush supermodel blowout: lifted, voluminous roots, a deep side part or soft center part, layers curled smoothly back and away from the front, bouncy rounded ends curving under and outward. Glossy, smooth, full-bodied, glamorous finish with lots of swing and movement. No bangs.
v-profundo: A long deep V-cut: the center back is the longest point, falling to the waist, and the perimeter angles sharply upward toward the sides, so the side and front lengths are noticeably shorter, around armpit level, forming a dramatic, pointed V. Long layers blend into the angle, and the tips are tapered thin and wispy. Middle part, smooth crown, sleek flowing lengths with a clear angular shape and light, piecey ends. No bangs. Keep the natural hair texture.
corte-rapunzel: An extra-long Rapunzel-length cut: the hair falls all the way to the waist or slightly below, with the full length kept dense and healthy from roots to ends. The perimeter is cut almost straight with a very slight rounding, and only very long, invisible layers start below the shoulder blades to give gentle movement. Middle part, smooth crown, lengths flowing over the shoulders and down the back, thick, healthy, polished ends. No bangs. Keep the natural hair texture.
camadas-arredondadas: A long cut with round layers: the length falls past the shoulder blades, and the layers are cut in a circular pattern around the head, starting at the chin and graduating evenly, creating a soft, rounded silhouette with fullness at the crown and sides. The ends curve slightly inward and the perimeter is softly rounded. Middle part, bouncy, smooth, voluminous finish with seamless blending and soft, polished movement. No bangs. Keep the natural hair texture.
feathered-longo: A long feathered cut: the length falls past the shoulder blades, with soft, razor-tapered feathered layers starting at the cheekbones and running through the sides and back. The front and side layers are brushed back and away in wing-like sweeps, the ends flicked outward. Center or soft side part, lifted roots, airy volume at the crown, light, fluffy, swept-back movement and wispy feathered tips. Bouncy, 70s-inspired yet modern blow-dried finish. No bangs.
camadas-pontas-para-fora: A long layered cut with flipped-out ends: the length falls just past the shoulder blades, with long layers starting at the chin and front pieces beginning at the jawline. Styled smooth with a round brush, so the ends of every layer and the perimeter flip upward and outward in a soft, bouncy curl, most visibly around the front and sides. Middle or side part, lifted crown, sleek glossy mid-lengths and playful, airy flipped ends. Polished, retro-modern finish. No bangs.
longo-assimetrico: A long asymmetrical cut with a deep side part: one side is cut noticeably shorter, falling to about the collarbone, while the other side and the back stay long, past the shoulder blades, with the perimeter angling diagonally from the short side to the long side. Soft layers blend along the diagonal, and the long side falls smoothly forward over the shoulder. Sleek, polished finish with clean, slightly tapered ends and a clear, intentional asymmetry. Keep the natural hair texture.
camadas-coreanas: A long Korean C-curl layered cut: the hair falls just past the shoulder blades, with soft, seamless layers starting at the chin and long front pieces at the jawline. Styled smooth, silky and glossy, with every layer and the ends curling gently inward into a soft C shape, the front pieces curving inward toward the jawline. Middle or slightly off-center part, light volume at the crown, airy, polished finish with neat rounded ends. No bangs.
hush-cut-longo: A long hush cut: the length falls just below the shoulder blades, cut with many soft, airy layers that start around the cheekbones and thin out gradually toward the ends, giving a light, feathery, slightly undone silhouette. Very sheer, wispy see-through bangs fall softly to eyebrow level and blend into the front layers. Gentle volume at the crown, soft, separated, wispy tapered ends, effortless, light, natural Korean-style finish. Keep the natural hair texture.
longo-lateral-raspada: A long cut with a shaved side (sidecut): on one side of the head, the section above and behind the ear, from the temple back, is clipper-shaved very short, about 3 mm, with a clean, sharp outline, while all the remaining hair stays long, falling past the shoulder blades and swept over to the opposite side with a deep side part. The long hair has soft, light layers and smooth flowing lengths. The shaved area is neat and clearly visible. Keep the natural hair texture.
jellyfish-cut-longo: A jellyfish cut: a two-tier shape where the top layer is cut into a blunt, chin-length bob all the way around, sitting like a cap over the rest of the hair, while the hair underneath stays long, falling past the shoulder blades. The contrast between the short blunt top tier and the long lower lengths is sharp and clearly disconnected. Middle part, no bangs, sleek, smooth, polished finish with crisp edges on the top tier and thin, tapered long ends. Keep the natural hair texture.
octopus-cut-longo: An octopus cut: a voluminous, rounded cap of short layers at the crown and top, cut to around the cheekbones and jawline, sitting over longer, thinner, separated lengths that fall past the shoulders like tentacles to about the shoulder blades. Wispy, piecey bangs blend into the short top layers. Lots of airy volume at the crown and a strong contrast between the full top and the thin, wispy, tapered ends. Textured, tousled, edgy finish. Keep the natural hair texture.
cachos-de-babyliss: A long layered cut falling to mid-back, styled with a curling iron into defined, glamorous spiral curls: uniform, bouncy, polished ringlets about 3 cm in diameter that begin around cheekbone level and spiral evenly down to the ends, turned away from the front on each side. Soft side part with smooth, lifted roots and a sleek crown, the curls lightly separated with the fingers for fullness and movement. Glossy, springy, salon-finished curls with crisp, defined curl shapes and no frizz.
liso-espelhado-longo: A long sleek straight style on hair falling to mid-back, with subtle, invisible long layers and a clean, softly tapered perimeter. Styled perfectly straight, as after a smoothing treatment and flat iron: every strand smooth, aligned and glossy from root to tip, with mirror-like glass-hair shine, no frizz, no waves and no curls. Sharp center part, smooth crown with a little natural root lift, the lengths hanging heavy and fluid like a silky sheet over the shoulders and down the back. The sleek straight texture is applied evenly to all of the hair.
